global_events: Twenty-one current official Auction House August 2026 records were decided; sixteen selected and five fail-closed.
Auction House UK, Savills, Allsop and SDL were checked; unused decision-ready evidence in this batch came from Auction House UK.
Sixteen current official source upgrades were retained, including seven full-direct pages and nine current search-result snapshots.
All retained candidates have future 10–11 August 2026 auction dates relative to 31 July 2026.
Twenty-one representative exact-address repository searches returned zero indexed hits; exhaustive duplicate proof is not claimed.
57 South Market Road was excluded because the current list showed an August event while the direct page showed Auction Ended 2 June 2026.
32 Park Village was excluded because the current list showed an August event while the direct page showed Auction Ended 31 March 2026.
Mineral House, 16 Rockland Villas and 27 Hamilton Mews were excluded because current property, tenure or occupational detail was insufficient.
Nine selected search-result snapshot records were constrained to currently exposed official evidence and were not expanded.
Seven selected records were verified on current official full-detail pages.
Guide prices and ranges are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher rent, yield, HMO and value-add wording was not independently underwritten.
Title, tenure, lease, service charges, parking, balcony and building obligations require legal-pack review.
Commercial and residential configuration and lawful use at Croft Road and Windsor Road were not independently verified.
Retirement eligibility and occupancy conditions at Montague Court require legal-pack and operator confirmation.
Apartment-building, communal-facility and building-safety matters require legal and professional review.
Refurbishment, measurements, services and condition require professional inspection.
Publisher vacancy or tenancy statements remain subject to legal-pack confirmation.
HMO, redevelopment, alternative-use and lawful-use outcomes were not inferred.
Buyer premiums, administration charges and legal-pack disbursements were not included in guide prices.
No second runner, owner or task was created; continuation key was preserved.
Research was divided across four bounded groups while GitHub writes remained serial.
Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
Public-host, parcel, geometry and final promotion remain blocked; no synthetic evidence was created.
